datasets.name: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance
datasets.identifier_evidence: Synthetic rows have no independent road-vehicle identity/group for automotive evaluation.
datasets.decision: Supporting/reference data only; excluded from automotive training.
datasets.reason: The dataset is explicitly synthetic industrial-machine data, not road-vehicle data.
datasets.license_evidence: UCI identifies the dataset as CC BY 4.0.
datasets.limitations: No automotive transfer or fleet generalization claim.

datasets.name: carOBD Toyota Etios telemetry
datasets.vehicle_component: One 2014 Toyota Etios; 27 OBD-II PIDs at 1 Hz across named driving/idle logs.
datasets.target: No confirmed fault, repair, maintenance, or EOL label; coolant-sensor anomalies are discussed as a research use.
datasets.identifier_evidence: Log filenames distinguish acquisition sessions/modes; the data describes one vehicle, not independent vehicle groups.
datasets.decision: Supporting telemetry only; suitable for exploratory single-vehicle sensor anomaly scoring, not validated fault or future-failure prediction.
datasets.reason: 129 CSV files contain 304,299 rows and 27 columns. The local README describes one Toyota Etios and 1 Hz collection; no ground-truth anomaly labels or confirmed outcomes are present.
datasets.source: https://github.com/eron93br/carOBD (local README cites a thesis/article on coolant-sensor anomaly detection).
datasets.license_evidence: No formal dataset license file was located; README says free to everyone and requests citation, which is not a precise license grant.
datasets.limitations: There are 42,537 within-file duplicate rows and substantial missingness, especially in warm-ups-since-clear. The repository has no clearly documented dataset license; verify reuse terms.

datasets.name: LEVIN vehicle telematics
datasets.vehicle_component: Four-wheel vehicle telematics described by documentation.
datasets.target: No local measurement export or maintenance outcome.
datasets.identifier_evidence: Documentation describes a multi-vehicle source, but no raw local data/IDs are available.
datasets.reason: The local folder contains documentation/notebooks but no raw measurement export; notebooks were not executed.
datasets.license_evidence: Local README states CC BY-NC-SA for the data; repository code MIT license is separate, and no raw data export is present.
datasets.limitations: No local data to prepare or evaluate.

datasets.name: NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Datasets
datasets.vehicle_component: Laboratory lithium-ion battery cells; not installed vehicle packs.
datasets.target: For selected cells, remaining discharge cycles to the documented 1.4 Ah capacity threshold.
datasets.identifier_evidence: Battery IDs are present in MAT filenames and used as cell groups; no fleet vehicle IDs.
datasets.decision: Suitable for a narrow laboratory battery-cell RUL experiment only.
datasets.reason: NASA battery documentation describes cycle-level discharge capacity and an explicit end-of-life threshold for selected cohorts. Cells without a reliable threshold crossing are excluded; cell ID enables group-disjoint evaluation.
datasets.license_evidence: No separate license statement was found in the local NASA bundle; verify reuse terms before redistribution.
datasets.limitations: Small number of independent cells; mixed temperatures and protocols; several cohorts lack a confirmed common stop threshold or contain anomalous capacities. Not evidence for vehicle/fleet maintenance.

datasets.name: Navarra motorcycle telemetry
datasets.vehicle_component: One motorcycle and rider across recorded sessions.
datasets.target: No confirmed failure, repair, maintenance, or RUL label.
datasets.identifier_evidence: Session/boot continuity identifiers exist for one motorcycle; no independent vehicle groups.
datasets.reason: Session telemetry has grouping context but lacks confirmed target outcomes and independent vehicles.
datasets.source: Local files and notes; origin/license claims not independently verified.
datasets.license_evidence: No locally verified dataset license; do not assume the cited unrelated campaign terms apply.
datasets.limitations: Cannot validate maintenance or failure predictions.

datasets.name: OBDex generic OBD-II code and PID reference

datasets.target: No observation-level model target; code-to-description reference entries only.
datasets.identifier_evidence: DTC and PID codes are reference identifiers, not vehicle/acquisition IDs.
datasets.decision: Supporting/reference data only; not a predictive-maintenance training dataset.
datasets.reason: The local README describes generic DTC/PID lookup content. It is not a set of confirmed vehicle events or repair outcomes.
datasets.license_evidence: Local LICENSE-DATA identifies CC0 1.0 for data; LICENSE-CODE separately identifies MIT for code.
datasets.limitations: The README reports 9,533 generic codes and 132 PIDs; local YAML/JSON files were inventoried but not used to infer fault prevalence or predictive labels.

task_decisions.sensor_anomaly_detection: No anomaly ground truth is available to validate anomalies as component faults. Unlabeled telemetry may support exploratory scoring only.
task_decisions.existing_fault_classification: No local vehicle dataset has both verified fault semantics and an independent vehicle/run holdout.
task_decisions.dtc_classification: No verified DTC-linked observations and group IDs were established.
task_decisions.future_component_failure_prediction: Unsupported: no verified time-linked fleet failure outcomes and vehicle-disjoint holdout were identified.
task_decisions.remaining_useful_life: Supported only as a limited laboratory battery-cell experiment using documented 1.4 Ah EOL cohorts and cells with observed valid threshold crossings. This is not vehicle battery-pack or fleet maintenance RUL.

battery_cohort_decisions.reason: Their local cohort README documents a 1.4 Ah/30% fade EOL and each positive capacity trajectory begins above and crosses 1.4 Ah.
The observed positive capacity sequence does not cross 1.4 Ah (minimum is about 1.4005 Ah); do not invent a crossing.

The local README says very low capacities occurred and their causes are not analyzed. The first observed <=1.4 Ah capacities are abrupt values around 0.06-0.08 Ah, so they are not accepted as reliable EOL targets.
The first valid positive capacity is already below the 1.4 Ah threshold.
The local README flags unexplained very low capacity readings; protocols/cutoff voltages differ, and a conservative first experiment uses the cleaner room-temperature cohort.
The local README says the experiment ended when control software crashed; the endpoint is not a documented EOL event.
The local README flags unexplained low capacities; observed initial capacities are below 1.4 Ah, so valid RUL-to-threshold trajectories cannot be formed.
The local cohort documentation does not establish a common 1.4 Ah stopping criterion; the observed capacity series do not provide the selected target.
Their local README specifies a different 1.6 Ah/20% fade criterion; they are not relabeled to the selected 1.4 Ah task.

excluded_battery_reason: Cohort-level reasons and observed capacity checks are enumerated in battery_cohort_decisions. No undocumented or unobserved EOL label is inferred.
